ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Ação DIA"), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "OQF"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "CVS/RVS"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "PSL"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "NEC"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "FPR") ), NOT(Cerimonia_Realizada__c) )
